records.tagline: AI cruise advisor with 15 line-specific expert advisors
records.description: 360Cruising is an AI cruise-planning platform with 15 advisors, each trained on one cruise line. Generic AI gives generic advice. 360Cruising tells you which cabin to book on Icon of the Seas, how Royal Caribbean's loyalty tiers compare to Norwegian's, and whether an itinerary is worth the premium. Plus a Cruise Match quiz, ship comparisons, destination guides and a loyalty tracker. Pro advisors pull live pricing.

records.name: BaseInvoice
records.tagline: Free EU e-invoice reader and validator
records.description: BaseInvoice opens any EU e-invoice — XRechnung, Factur-X, ZUGFeRD, Peppol BIS, UBL, CII — right in your browser. Drop an XML or hybrid PDF and read it as a clean, structured invoice in seconds. Nothing is uploaded: every file is processed locally, so no account and no data ever leaves the machine. Free to view. Validate against EN 16931, batch-process, and export to Excel or PDF when you need more. Built for the 2025–2028 EU e-invoicing mandates, in EN, DE, FR & NL.

records.name: Zernio WhatsApp API
records.tagline: One API for WhatsApp: messaging, calling, and AI agents
records.description: You knew Zernio as the API for social media. Now it does WhatsApp too, the whole thing. Connect a number and you've got the entire WhatsApp Business API behind it: messaging and broadcasts, in-chat forms, calls you can route to AI agents, chatbots, group chats, and numbers in 53 countries. Whatever you need to build on WhatsApp, it's one integration. Made for developers and the agents they build: REST, SDKs, CLI, and a hosted MCP server. Official WhatsApp Business API. Zero markup on usage.

records.name: Page Deltas
records.tagline: Catch every change on the web that matters to your team
records.description: AI-powered alternative to Visualping for website change monitoring. Monitor competitor pricing, public docs, careers pages, regulatory updates — anything on the open web — and let AI analyze the changes for you. Get a ping on Slack, Teams, Discord, Webhook, or email, the moment anything important changes.

records.name: Snap Deck HQ
records.tagline: Everything you need in one native macOS command bar
records.description: Snap Deck is an intelligent all-in-one command palette built natively for macOS. Press ⌃⌥Space to launch apps, manage files, and automate workflows instantly without a mouse. ⚡ Features: • Smart Clipboard: Search & paste history • AI Text Tools: Summarize & format code/text • File & Image Power Tools: Batch rename, image resize, image compression & built-in OCR • Automations: Set custom app triggers • Privacy-First: 100% local, on-device processing Supercharge your Mac productivity in seconds.

records.name: D.A.D. App (Doing it All Day)
records.tagline: From Diapers to Diplomas, we are the GPS for Fatherhood!
records.description: From Diapers to Diplomas the D.A.D. App Platform is your all-in-one parenting Coach, providing expert advice, essential support services, adventure planning, DIY projects, and a supportive community for every father.

records.name: Letras Bonitas
records.tagline: Beautiful aesthetic fonts for every mood
records.description: Crea letras aesthetic para Instagram, TikTok, Free Fire y más. Copia y pega fuentes con estilo, símbolos y estilos de texto lindos gratis.

records.name: Zap!
records.tagline: Electric Trivia
records.description: Press-your-luck trivia for iPhone & iPad: win the trivia race, then flip cards to bank points — but don't draw a Zap. Duel friends over Game Center or right inside iMessage. 21 categories, 5,000+ questions, updated over the air.

records.name: FlowMarket
records.tagline: The marketplace built to buy and sell ai assets
records.description: The marketplace for premium digital assets. Buy and sell professional templates, automation workflows, and productivity tools from verified creators worldwide.

records.name: Mappamory
records.tagline: Map-based contacts for people, places, and moments
records.description: Mappamory turns contacts into a private map. Record people, places, photos, and moments together, with local data by default, no social feed, and no live location tracking.

records.name: Mamenza
records.tagline: Free pregnancy tools & baby names for German & Dutch parents
records.description: Mamenza is a free pregnancy knowledge hub for German and Dutch-speaking parents. Tools include a due date calculator, pregnancy week tracker, maternity leave calculator, baby name generator (50k+ names), and birth plan creator. Ad-free, expert-written, no registration needed.

records.name: Battery Alarm
records.tagline: Smart battery alerts — never overcharge or drain again
records.description: Battery Alarm is a smart Android app that keeps your battery in the safe zone at all times. Set custom alerts for any battery level — get notified before you overcharge or completely drain your device. ✨ Key Features: • Set multiple alarm thresholds (e.g. 20% & 80%) • Customizable alert sounds & vibration • Real-time charge speed & voltage monitoring • Home screen widgets for instant status • Light & dark theme support • In-app purchase for premium features

records.name: AskGoDo — Turn ideas into action
records.tagline: AI task manager that turns ideas into action
records.description: AskGoDo helps you capture ideas, tasks, reminders, and projects in one place, then uses AI to turn them into clear next steps. Plan your day, manage deadlines, organize work across web and mobile, and move from thinking to doing faster.

records.name: TCI Journal
records.tagline: Track trades, fix mistakes, grow consistently
records.description: TCI Journal helps traders build discipline through structured trade journaling. Log every trade, review your mistakes, track win rate, risk-reward, and trading psychology, and analyze your performance with actionable insights. Built for Forex, crypto, and stock traders who want to trade consistently instead of emotionally.

records.name: Amberbird
records.tagline: Your visa process, explained step by step.
records.description: AI-powered immigration guidance for H-1B, F-1/OPT, and green card applicants. Plain-English answers backed by official USCIS sources. Start free.

records.name: Firecrawl Research Index
records.tagline: An index for agents pushing the frontier of AI/ML research
records.description: AI/ML research moves fast, and the work that matters is split between new papers and the code that implements them. Most search providers omit or misrank key papers, leaving you to review sources by hand without ever being sure you've caught everything. So we built an index for it. Firecrawl's index includes all 3M+ arXiv papers, as well as GitHub artifacts from top research repos, refreshed daily so agents always stay current.

records.name: Online PS Editor
records.tagline: Free Online Image Editor in Your Browser
records.description: Use the best Photoshop online free alternative. Online PS Editor lets you edit photos, manage complex layers, and remove backgrounds with AI directly in your web browser. No signup, no download, 100% free.

records.name: bench-press-calculator
records.tagline: Calculate your true bench press 1RM in seconds
records.description: Convert dumbbell to barbell bench press. Calculate 1RM with 5 formulas. Track progress. Free tool. No signup.

records.name: WhisperMobile
records.tagline: Transcription that stays on your device, nowhere else
records.description: WhisperMobile: Your private transcription assistant, powered by your device, not the cloud. Transform speech and audio files into text entirely on your iPhone or iPad — nothing leaves your device. No cloud uploads. No account. No tracking. ✨ 100% on-device AI • 🎤 Live transcription • 🔒 Apple Intelligence-powered • 🌍 100+ languages Perfect for journalists, doctors, lawyers, remote workers & anyone who believes their data is theirs.

records.name: Midjourney Scanner
records.tagline: 60 second ultrasound-based full-body scanner that beats MRI
records.description: Midjourney Medical is reimagining health scanning. Step into a shallow pool of warm, golden light and a ring of sensors uses gentle sound waves to map your body in detail—in about 60 seconds. No radiation, no stress. It pairs with the Midjourney Spa: a relaxing place with hot tubs, saunas, and cold plunges where the scan is just a side effect. Go often, build a rich library of health data over time, and catch things early. Affordable, casual body imaging for everyone.

records.name: Sitaare.ai
records.tagline: What do the stars tell about you?
records.description: Sitaare AI is an AI-powered Vedic astrology platform that transforms traditional astrology reports into interactive conversations. Users can explore personalized insights, ask follow-up questions, and understand astrological guidance in a more accessible way. The combination of Vedic astrology and conversational AI creates a more engaging experience than static horoscope tools.

records.name: Pinoyflix - Pinoy TV
records.tagline: Pinoy Tambayan - Pinoy Teleserye | Pinoy Lambingan
records.description: Watch Your Favourite Pinoyflix Pinoy Tambayan, Pinoy TV, Pinoy Channel, Teleserye Replay, Pinoy Lambingan and Pinoy Flix Shows Online For Free From anywhere in the world.
